immersive_bakery.toaster.press: Press the lever to start toasting
immersive_bakery.blender.holds_liquid: Draw the liquid out of the bowl first
immersive_bakery.moka_pot.no_heat: Needs a lit heat source below
immersive_bakery.moka_pot.take: Right-click to take the moka pot with coffee
immersive_bakery.stone_kiln.put: Take the peel and push it into the kiln
immersive_bakery.stone_kiln.turn: Time to turn it: push the peel under it in the middle and swing it all the way to one side
immersive_bakery.stone_kiln.turn_from_le: Push it in from the far left and swing it back to the middle
immersive_bakery.stone_kiln.turn_from_ri: Push it in from the far right and swing it back to the middle
immersive_bakery.stone_kiln.take: It is done: take it out with the peel
immersive_bakery.stone_kiln.unload: Take what lies on the peel off first
immersive_bakery.dough_crafting_table.ro: Take the rolling pin and roll the dough out flat
immersive_bakery.dough_crafting_table.di: Press and hold the dough to divide it into %s pieces
immersive_bakery.dough_crafting_table.sh: Press and hold each piece to shape it
immersive_bakery.fermentation_tank.empty: Put in whole wheat flour and water for yeast, or pour in a bucket of milk for cheese
immersive_bakery.fermentation_tank.flour: Whole wheat flour %s/%s · no water yet
immersive_bakery.fermentation_tank.milk: Milk %s/%s · fill it up and add salt, or take it with a glass bottle
immersive_bakery.fermentation_tank.milk_: Milk %s/%s · add salt, or take it with a glass bottle
immersive_bakery.fermentation_tank.yeast: %s bottles of yeast · take it with a glass bottle
immersive_bakery.drink_cup.empty: Put in ice and what else the drink needs, in any order
immersive_bakery.drink_cup.shake: %s: hold the cup and shake it up and down
immersive_bakery.bread.loosen: Take the knife and cut all the way round in the mould · A/D to turn
immersive_bakery.bread.layers: Take the knife and cut along the line on its side, into %s layers · A/D to turn
immersive_bakery.bread.cut: Take the knife and cut along the lines, into %s slices · A/D to turn
immersive_bakery.cake_box.untie: Hold the ribbon and pull it off
